description: A blog post as a reader who still holds its link meets it. This scenario used to show the Welcome post, which was retired when the blog was hidden for launch — the owner decided on 2026-09-14 not to advertise a blog until there are real articles for it. So it now shows one of the ten Medium stubs instead, which is what a retained link actually resolves to: the posts keep building at their own URLs even with every route INTO the blog closed, so nobody holding an old link gets a 404. Note what is ABSENT — the back link that used to sit above the title is gone, because with the blog hidden there is no index for it to return to.
